description: A script for rebuilding specific files with debug information in the PyTorch project, mimicking build commands, creating symlinks, and checking build environment.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Executes a command and returns its output as a string.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for verbose flag and files to process.

methods.name: get_lib_extension
methods.description: Returns the library file extension based on the platform.

methods.name: create_symlinks
methods.description: Creates symlinks from build/lib to torch/lib for library files.

methods.name: has_build_ninja
methods.description: Checks if the build.ninja file exists in the build directory.

methods.name: is_devel_setup
methods.description: Checks if the current environment is a development setup of PyTorch.

methods.name: create_build_plan
methods.description: Generates a list of build commands for files that need to be rebuilt.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the build process, argument parsing, and environment checks.
